services.value: Environmental compliance, including on-site testing & monitoring and laboratory testing & analysis. Source testing (e.g., stack testing, CEMS/temp CEMS, engine testing, RNG, fugitive emissions, ambient air, LDAR, OGI, SkyBridge software) plus environmental consulting (air, water, natural resources), compliance services (e.g., LDAR compliance audits & management, EHS compliance as a service, OSHA training), and assessment & remediation (Phase I & II environmental site assessments and remediation of contamination in soil, water, and air).
